message: My misinterpretation of this is an example of what I was complaining before: my inability to step outside of myself.  It's as a writer and a reader at times.  I interpret everything in terms of how I can relate to it personally.  I didn't comment for an entire week after I read that post but I still didn't get it.  I read it as perhaps a parable of how a man may literally wield the power to affect a pregnancy.  Sigh.
